title: opencode-permission-audit — find why an opencode agent is prompted, fix its permission map
description: Use this skill when an opencode agent prompts for permission on every command, when a dispatched subagent's command fails with a permission error ('The user rejected permission…' or 'The user has specified a rule which prevents you from using this specific tool call'), or when you need to audit and repair an agent's permission.bash map. Ships a scanner (scripts/opencode-permission-scan.py) that mines the opencode log and session DB for every permission ask, inferred answer, working directory, wasted time, deny catalog and auto-reject, plus a per-agent bash-map verdict with a drop-in corrected permission block. Includes the opencode inspection cheatsheet and the rules of permission resolution (merge order, last-match-wins, agent-map shadowing, atomic bash calls, non-interactive ask auto-reject).
author: sox-ecosystem

agent.description: Agent id to audit (e.g. git-manager). Omit to audit every installed agent.

out_path.description: Path for the full report. Defaults to a temp file named opencode-perms-<agent>-*.txt.

agents_dir.description: Directory of installed agent .md files. Defaults to ~/.config/opencode/agents.

permission_prompts.description: Number of permission prompts attributed to the agent.

verdict.description: Section 7 verdict for the agent's bash map (e.g. DEFECT / ok).
